decision_reason: APCR1h has lowest max|e|, P2P, and band violations. APCR1m is 2.4x worse due to excessive wheel velocity damping and position cap saturation.
recommendations: APCR1h should remain the default for low_0p300 boundary-height operation
APCR1m should be ABANDONED as a standalone profile
APCR1n should be designed targeting reduced wheel damping and relaxed position cap during RECENTER
